titulo: Badenoch and Farage in spat over Chagos Islands, as she calls his offer to Trump ‘humiliating’ – UK politics live
cuerpo: Nigel Farage says Kemi Badenoch misinterpreted his suggestion for a deal with Donald Trump Here are more comments from Kemi Badenoch on what Nigel Farage told a US podcast about wanting to make an offer to President Trump in relation to the Chagos Islands. (See 9.56am .) It is mad for someone who wants to be prime minister to say we should give away one piece of British territory just to stop an American President talking about another … Nigel Farage has made such a huge fuss about defending the Chagos Islands. He calls this making a deal. Giving away British territory in return for someone keeping quiet is not a deal. It is humiliating. Continue reading...
